summary: L-4 cab built 1929 about 7 miles west of Superior, abandoned 1946 and destroyed 1952; sources disagree on the county.

evidence.quote: This L-4 cab, built in 1929, was abandoned in 1946 and destroyed in 1952.

evidence.supports: entry places it in the Lolo National Forest
FFLA row: Missoula County, 47.18064 -115.05476, ground, gone
other Sheep Mountain rows on the list, e.g. Lincoln County

corrections.why: The firelookout.com entry gives Mineral County and places the site 7 miles west of Superior. The record's Missoula comes from the FFLA list, which disagrees. Editor to confirm.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says Mineral County; the FFLA list says Missoula for the same coordinates. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Two sources agree on the dates and the L-4 cab but disagree on the county. The FFLA list also has a 'Sheep Mountain' in Missoula County at 46.94777, -113.80678 (gone) and one in Lincoln County; this record is tied to the 47.18064 row by its link, so the match is by name and location. Sheep Mountain lookouts in Wyoming and Washington turned up in searches and are unrelated; they are not used. No source describes the site today.
